panel.label: Label (optional)
panel.manual_hint: Coordinates are rounded to two decimal places before they are sent to Open-Meteo.
panel.noctalia_note: Only manual coordinates or an address you typed in Noctalia are imported. IP-based auto-locate is never reused.
panel.no_location: No location is set. The clock still works.
panel.invalid_coords: Enter a latitude between -90 and 90 and a longitude between -180 and 180
panel.noctalia_auto: Noctalia is set to auto-locate. Use a manual location here so this widget never reuses IP-derived coordinates.
panel.noctalia_missing: No manual coordinates are set in Noctalia
panel.noctalia_address_missing: No address is set in Noctalia
panel.privacy: Only rounded coordinates and your IP are sent to Open-Meteo. No automatic IP lookup, no history, no analytics.

refresh_minutes.label: Refresh weather
refresh_minutes.description: How often to request a new forecast. Open-Meteo is polled politely; failures back off up to one hour.

units.label: Units
units.description: Auto follows Noctalia's weather unit when it is readable, otherwise metric. The published state always stays metric.

clock_source.label: Clock source
clock_source.description: Auto uses the weather location's timezone when available and falls back to system time. System always uses local time. Location uses the weather timezone even when it differs from the system.

clock_format.label: Clock format
clock_format.description: Auto follows Noctalia's time format. 24h and 12h force a specific format.

show_seconds.label: Show seconds
show_seconds.description: Show seconds in the clock and bar widget. The card redraws once per second instead of once per minute.

date_style.label: Date style
date_style.description: Auto follows Noctalia's date format. Weekday shows only the weekday, short shows a compact date, hidden removes the date.

secondary_timezone.label: Secondary timezone
secondary_timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone shown under the clock, for example Europe/Berlin. Leave empty to hide it.

secondary_label.label: Secondary timezone label
secondary_label.description: Label shown before the secondary time, for example Home or Work.

scene.label: Weather scene
scene.description: Auto follows the current condition. Off uses the plain themed card. A fixed scene keeps the same scenery regardless of the forecast.

scene_theme.label: Scene time of day
scene_theme.description: Auto uses day/night from the forecast. Night and Day force the scene palette.

animate_effects.label: Animate effects
animate_effects.description: Animate the scene frames: rain, snow and lightning at 180 ms; stars, clouds and fog at a 420 ms ambient cadence.

background.label: Host panel background
background.description: Let Noctalia draw its surface behind the card. The scene still draws inside the card; turn this off to place the card directly on the wallpaper.

background_color.label: Panel colour
background_color.description: Host panel fill colour. Accepts a hex colour or palette role. Handled by Noctalia, not the plugin.

background_opacity.label: Panel opacity
background_opacity.description: Host panel opacity, applied live by Noctalia.

background_radius.label: Panel corner radius
background_radius.description: Host panel corner radius in logical px.

background_padding.label: Panel padding
background_padding.description: Space between the host panel edge and the card content in logical px.

show_card_settings.label: Show card settings
show_card_settings.description: Reveal the title, width, layout, fill and border controls. Current values stay active while hidden.

show_styling.label: Show styling controls
show_styling.description: Reveal the colour, divider and automatic scene text controls. Current values stay active while hidden.

show_scaling.label: Show scaling controls
show_scaling.description: Reveal the text scale, clock size and forecast glyph size controls. Current values stay active while hidden.

show_sections.label: Show section toggles
show_sections.description: Reveal the header, date, condition, forecast, details, location, update, attribution and compact-layout controls. Current values stay active while hidden.

show_scene.label: Show background scene
show_scene.description: Draw the full-bleed weather scene. Turn off to keep only the clock, text and weather glyphs on a plain transparent or themed card.

title.label: Card title
title.description: Heading shown when the optional header is enabled.

content_width.label: Content width
content_width.description: Width of the card content in logical px. Match this to the tile width for a tight fit.

card_gap.label: Card gap
card_gap.description: Space between the optional header and the scene. Inner content spacing stays fixed so the scene height remains stable.

card_padding.label: Card padding
card_padding.description: Inner padding between the card edge and the clock/weather content.

card_radius.label: Card corner radius
card_radius.description: Corner radius of the scene image and plain card surface.

card_fill_color.label: Plain card fill
card_fill_color.description: Fill used when the weather scene is off. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

card_fill_opacity.label: Plain card fill opacity
card_fill_opacity.description: Opacity of the plain card fill, from 0 to 1.

card_border_color.label: Plain card border
card_border_color.description: Border used when the weather scene is off. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

card_border_width.label: Plain card border width
card_border_width.description: Border thickness of the plain card in logical px.

show_header.label: Show header
show_header.description: Show the title and refresh/settings buttons above the scene.

show_date.label: Show date
show_date.description: Show the date under the clock.

show_condition_text.label: Show condition text
show_condition_text.description: Show the condition description next to the temperature. The glyph is always shown.

show_forecast.label: Show forecast
show_forecast.description: Show the next-day forecast strip under the current conditions.

forecast_days.label: Forecast days
forecast_days.description: Number of forecast rows to show after today.

show_details.label: Show details
show_details.description: Show feels-like, wind, humidity and precipitation under the forecast.

show_location.label: Show location
show_location.description: Show the location label in the footer.

show_updated.label: Show update age
show_updated.description: Show how long ago the forecast was fetched.

show_attribution.label: Show attribution
show_attribution.description: Show the Open-Meteo credit in the footer. Weather data is provided by Open-Meteo under CC BY 4.0.

compact_layout.label: Compact layout
compact_layout.description: Reduce padding and clock size, hide the details row, hide the timezone/secondary clock and hide footer labels. Use this for short desktop tiles so the clock and forecast never overlap.

text_color.label: Primary text colour
text_color.description: Clock, temperature and values. Accepts a hex colour or palette role. A custom value applies over the scene too; at the default on_surface role the scene uses its light default.

muted_text_color.label: Secondary text colour
muted_text_color.description: Dates, labels, units and footers. Accepts a hex colour or palette role. A custom value applies over the scene too; at the default on_surface_variant role the scene uses its light default.

divider_color.label: Divider colour
divider_color.description: Divider under the current conditions. Accepts a hex colour or palette role.

divider_width.label: Divider thickness
divider_width.description: Thickness of the content divider in logical px.

scene_auto_text.label: Automatic scene text
scene_auto_text.description: Use light scene defaults for colours that are still at their default palette roles. Any explicit colour value wins in both scene and text-only mode.

text_scale.label: Text size
text_scale.description: Global text multiplier for the clock, temperature and all labels. Use Small text size below to adjust dates, labels and footers independently.

small_text_scale.label: Small text size
small_text_scale.description: Extra multiplier for dates, the timezone label, condition text, high/low, forecast labels, details and footer text. The clock and temperature stay controlled by Text size and Clock size.

clock_size.label: Clock size
clock_size.description: Clock font size in logical px before text scaling (28–96).

forecast_glyph_size.label: Forecast glyph size
forecast_glyph_size.description: Weather glyph size in the forecast strip (12–36).

mode.label: Bar mode
mode.description: Show weather, the clock, or both in the bar widget.

show_temperature.label: Show temperature
show_temperature.description: Show the current temperature beside the bar glyph.

show_condition.label: Show condition
show_condition.description: Show the condition text in the bar widget.

glyph.label: Fallback glyph
glyph.description: Glyph used before weather data is available.

weather_color.label: Weather icon colour
weather_color.description: Weather glyphs and forecast glyphs. Accepts a hex colour or palette role. A custom value applies over the scene too; the automatic scene default is only used while this stays at the primary role.
